sections.sectionSummaryBrief: This section explains that the imprisonment of the Mitteler Rebbe caused a greater elevation in the revelation of the inner dimensions of Torah, specifically through the aspect of Daat, and connects this to the discourse delivered on the eve of redemption.

translations.translation: And it can be said that this is also the connection of the delivery of this discourse on the last Shabbos of the imprisonment,
the eve of the day of redemption,
for it is known that through the imprisonment there was brought about
(an opening was effected)
a much greater elevation, etc.
And analogous to the statement of our sages of blessed memory,
"The olive, when it is crushed"
(specifically)
"it gives forth its oil."
And although the matter of "your springs will burst forth" existed also before the imprisonment
(of the Mitteler Rebbe),
nevertheless,
through the imprisonment there was an addition in this,
and it can be said that it was an addition beyond measure,
and according to the precise wording of our sages that through crushing "it gives forth its oil"
(specifically "gives forth"),
for "one who gives, gives with a generous eye."
And the greatness of the elevation that was innovated specifically through the imprisonment is understood from what is explained in the sicha of my father-in-law, the Rebbe,
(regarding the imprisonment of the Alter Rebbe,
and from this it is also understood regarding the imprisonment of the Mitteler Rebbe),
that the imprisonment was with his consent,
for every tzaddik rules and controls all of his physical matters,
and every occurrence that happens to him is with his consent.
And from the fact that he consented to the imprisonment even though it was connected with suffering, etc., and with the prevention of the dissemination of Chassidus
(during his time in prison),
from this is understood the greatness of the elevation of the dissemination of the wellsprings that was innovated specifically after his redemption,
to the extent that for this, the entire imprisonment was worthwhile.
And this is the connection of the delivery of this discourse to
(the eve of)
the redemption,
for then a greater elevation was innovated in the revelation of the inner dimensions of Torah,
[the aspect of Yechidah of Torah],
a revelation in understanding and comprehension,
and to the extent that the revelation is not only in Chochmah and Binah but also in the aspect of Daat,
for the root of Daat is in the innerness of Keter,
[and as is explained at length in the Hemshech of Atemah Ratzon
the superiority of the matter of Daat],
the aspect of Yechidah.
For this is "Your children will recognize and know that from You is their rest,"
for the revelation of the aspect of Yechidah
("from You is their rest")
is specifically in the matter of Daat,
"they will recognize... and know."

sections.sectionSummaryBrief: This section explains that in the Messianic era, Moshiach will teach Daat to all the people, a tangible revelation of Divinity like water covering the sea, perceived with physical sight.

translations.translation: And this is also that Moshiach will teach Daat to all the people in the comprehension of the inner dimensions of Torah,
specifically Daat,
for the main matter that will be innovated in the days of Moshiach is
[as the Rambam writes at the conclusion and seal of his book]
"for the earth will be filled with Daat of Havayah,"
specifically Daat.
And this revelation will be in a manner of "as water covers the sea,"
meaning that this will be
(in addition to the Daat and recognition of the intellect,
also)
with tangible sight,
like the waters of the sea that are seen with tangible sight.
For it is explained in many places
regarding the creations of the world of concealment, that they are analogous to fish in the sea that are nullified to the water,
to the extent that the existence of the fish is not seen at all, and what is seen is only the waters of the sea that cover them.
And from this it is understood that the meaning of "as water covers the sea" is that the revelation of Divinity will then be with tangible sight,
like the waters of the sea
(that cover the creations within them)
that are seen with tangible sight.

sections.sectionSummaryBrief: This concluding section expresses the wish that through studying these matters, the prophecy of the Messianic era will be fulfilled, when the earth will be filled with Daat of Havayah.

translations.translation: May it be His will that from the study of these matters in Torah, there will soon come about the fulfillment of the promise
(of these matters)
in actuality,
that out of true rest and out of joy and a good heart we will go towards the true and complete redemption through Moshiach our righteous one,
when "the earth will be filled with Daat of Havayah as water covers the sea."
